created_prompt: Can you devise a three year plan about launching and publishing a cookbook for Julie. She posts cooking videos about quick healthy recipies and has 1.2 million followers. She wants to publish a cookbook but she doesn't know how to publish it. She wants to know the difference between traditional publishing methods and self publishing. She currently works 4 days a week and has limited time and a limited budget. Can you make her a three year plan to help accomplish this goal.
